task: Generate a vertical architectural structure using numerous variations of small cuboids, small cubes, and other small linear rectangular geometries. The priority is to generate a vertical architectural structure that most closely resembles the three reference images provided. The vertical architectural structure should be generated using subtractive boolean operations where necessary and should not have any intersecting geometries. Focus on creating a detailed facade that resembles the look of the three reference images. Make sure that all 4 facades share similar details. The roof/ceiling should also have some additional detail elements. Add additional voids, windows, and gutter details to create a non-flat facade.
